about_the_game:
Scavenge for items, Fortify your safehouses, and Defend your community of survivors against the growing zombie horde in this strategic roguelite tower defense game!

Survivors are flawed, death is around every corner, and your choices matter!

Features:

  • Randomized Survivors

Survivors act as your towers, except they can get tired, infected, and DIE!

They each have different weapons, traits, and can level up, giving you unique combinations!

  • Choices Matter

Every run of a level is different, so bring in your favourite strategy, but be prepared to adapt to changes!

  • Scavenge For Rewards

Assign your survivors to scavenge for supplies, relics, and finding new survivors.

Be careful, scavenging comes with risks like infection, negative traits, and even attracting more powerful zombies for the next wave!

  • Fortify Locations

Clear scavenge locations to turn them into defensive positions, each with their own bonuses.

A tall water tower provides more range, while a secure storefront may boost your survivor's damage reduction.

Improve your defenses with fortifications to further customize your defense!

  • Defend Against The Horde

Do you cover more zombie routes? or ensure your survivors can protect each other? Who is keeping the community's RV safe? These are important decisions to avoid being overrun by the undead horde!

  • Special Zombies

Walkers, Runners, Spitters, Brutes, and more! Lots of different types of zombies to kill!

Wishlist & Follow us to keep an eye on the game as it develops!

We appreciate your interest and support!
